notes: No mechanical parent hierarchy, bone rig, constraints, drivers, or animation actions found. Objects are independent generic-named meshes/curves.

Some wheel origins coincide with axle centres, but spoke origins lie along their individual shafts and frame/contact points are not globally standardized pivots. Rebuild semantic roots and hinge axes before use.

Model uses unlabelled Blender units with many unapplied/nonuniform scales. Uniform scaling to 698 mm tire diameter gives wheelbase about 1104 mm and tire width about 17.5 mm, incompatible with target 1075 mm and 38 mm. Whole-bike uniform scaling cannot meet all target dimensions.
Only 12 separated spoke candidates per wheel, so wheel geometry is not a suitable direct replacement for target 32-spoke wheels.

Material node trees contain no image texture nodes. Bike Reference.jpg is an unused, unpacked missing reference; graffiti_shelter_8k.hdr is an unpacked missing environment. They are not included in the ZIP and their license is not established by this asset package.
Remove backdrop, camera, lights, missing reference/environment dependencies; rebuild glTF-compatible material assignments and verify export in a later adaptation phase.
Good candidate for geometry extraction and shape reference because of many separated CC0 pieces and moderate triangle count. Not a pre-rigged, dimension-accurate commute-bicycle runtime asset.

dimension_measurements.source_axes_inferred_from_wheels: X front, Y across bicycle, Z up; wheel axle is along Y
dimension_measurements.spoke_count_qualification: 24 individually separate slender cylinder candidates, 12 at each wheel centre; not 32 spokes per wheel. Identified from world position and geometry, not semantic authored names.
